name: @iarna/toml

scripts.prepare: npm run setup-burntsushi-toml-suite && npm run setup-iarna-toml-suite
scripts.benchmark: node benchmark.js && node benchmark-per-file.js && node results2table.js
scripts.update-coc: weallbehave -o . && git add CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md && git commit -m 'docs(coc): updated CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md'
scripts.update-contrib: weallcontribute -o . && git add CONTRIBUTING.md && git commit -m 'docs(contributing): updated CONTRIBUTING.md'
scripts.setup-iarna-toml-suite: [ -d test/spec-test ] || (git clone https://github.com/iarna/toml-spec-tests -b 1.0.0-rc.1 test/spec-test; rimraf test/spec-test/.git/hooks/*); cd test/spec-test; git pull
scripts.setup-burntsushi-toml-suite: [ -d test/burntsushi-toml-test ] || (git clone https://github.com/BurntSushi/toml-test test/burntsushi-toml-test; rimraf test/burntsushi-toml-test/.git/hooks/*); cd test/burntsushi-toml-test; git pull

description: Better TOML parsing and stringifying all in that familiar JSON interface.
